request.text: A short-range brass flamethrower spraying steadily: controlled pressurized fuel hiss underneath a soft dense fluttering flame roar. Medium intensity, no crackling bonfire, no explosion, no dramatic swell. Steady seamless looping game ambience, consistent texture at the start and end, no distinct beginning or ending, no large one-shot accents. No music, no speech, no crowd, no modern electronic siren.
